{{Top|leg}}
'''Cargo pods''', also known as '''cargo modules''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> were carrying pods that carried cargo, supplies, and were used for transportation of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] like [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. Cargo pods had a wide spectrum of uses, from impromptu dwellings to gun [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], being able to carry several thousand weapons apiece
